origins.section: Containment Is Proved Row by Row: Each Weak Row Is a Sum of Strong Ones
The Share of the Gap Closed Puts Two Bounds on One Scale
The Solver's Root Bound Is the Second Measurement

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-containment: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-containment: "if each row of formulation B is a sum of rows of A ... then R_A ⊆ R_B" and "R_A ⊆ R_B ⟹ z_LP(A) ≤ z_LP(B) for every objective (maximizing)". So A's LP bound is never higher.
recorded.prompt:q-gap-closed: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.prompt:q-root-bound: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-root-bound: "Since the root bound is the bound after presolve and cuts, those steps recovered at least everything the aggregated rows had lost."

recorded.prompt:q-containment:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-containment:a: "a stronger formulation is not a promise of a smaller search"; on GridCap small the weak form took 72 nodes and the strong form 82.
recorded.prompt:q-containment:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-containment:c: "Two formulations of the same problem have the same S". The two forms have the same optimum, 17,748, so A's best plan is not worth less.
recorded.prompt:q-containment:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-containment:d: The implication runs the other way, z_LP(A) ≤ z_LP(B). In all 30 objectives the stronger form's bound was strictly lower, so B's bound can be higher.
recorded.prompt:q-gap-closed:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap-closed:a: The formula's denominator is z_LP(weak) − z_IP (200), not the old bound.
recorded.prompt:q-gap-closed:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap-closed:b: The denominator is the weak gap, not z_IP alone.
recorded.prompt:q-gap-closed:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap-closed:c: The formula's numerator is the drop between the bounds (120), not the gap left over (80).
recorded.prompt:q-root-bound:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-root-bound:b: "with binary values the two forms allow exactly the same plans" and "a stronger formulation is not a promise of a smaller search".
recorded.prompt:q-root-bound:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-root-bound:c: "An LP bound is what the formulation says by itself". The root bound comes after presolve and cuts, so it is a separate measurement and can differ.
recorded.prompt:q-root-bound:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-root-bound:d: "the two forms allow exactly the same plans", so the weak form has no extra whole plans.
